## 🔴 High Impact

### NFLX — Netflix · **BEARISH**
> Q4 revenue guide + ad revenue outlook disappoint; stock -6% premarket

Netflix reported Q3 2026 after close on October 20. Revenue rose 12% YoY to **$12.9B** with operating margin at 35% — both broadly in line. EPS beat estimates. However, Q4 revenue guidance came in below Street expectations and management signaled a **cut to ad-tier revenue outlook**, sparking a sharp sell-off. Shares dropped ~6% in premarket on October 21. Co-CEO Ted Sarandos flagged two structural challenges in an interview separate from the earnings call. Stock is now roughly 26% below its 2026 peak.

**Why it matters:** NFLX had been one of the portfolio's steadier large-cap names. The Q4 guide miss and ad monetization wobble change the near-term narrative; watch for analyst target cuts throughout the day.

Sources: [Gurufocus — NFLX Q3 Earnings Exceed Expectations but Stock Drops](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9133450/netflix-nflx-q3-earnings-exceed-expectations-but-stock-drops-due-to-ad-revenue-outlook) · [Gurufocus — NFLX Shares Drop 6% Premarket](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9133525/netflix-nflx-shares-drop-6-premarket-on-weaker-q4-revenue-outlook) · [StockTitan — Netflix Q3 2026 earnings: revenue $12.9B](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/NFLX/netflix-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-12-billion-35pct-margin.html)

### INTC — Intel · **BULLISH**
> JPMorgan upgrades to Neutral after 4 years of bearish rating; shares +2% premarket

JPMorgan **upgraded Intel to Neutral** today — the first upgrade from the bank in four years — citing improved execution. The $85 price target was maintained. TD Cowen simultaneously cut its price target, creating a split view. Intel shares surged ~2% in premarket alongside Nvidia and AMD. Separately, a StocksToTrade note highlights AI bets and "Terafab jitters" as the conflicting forces in play.

**Why it matters:** JPMorgan's multi-year bear finally capitulating is a notable sentiment shift. It doesn't imply a strong buy, but it removes one of the most visible institutional overhangs.

Sources: [Ad-Hoc News — JPMorgan upgrades Intel to Neutral](https://ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/jpmorgan-upgrades-intel-stock-to-neutral-after-four-years/70382168) · [Defense World — TD Cowen cuts INTC target](https://www.defenseworld.net/2026/10/21/intel-nasdaqintc-stock-price-target-cut-by-td-cowen.html) · [Invezz — NVDA/AMD/INTC surge premarket](https://invezz.com/news/2026/10/21/why-nvidia-amd-and-intel-stocks-are-surging-up-to-2-in-premarket-today/)
